text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way home from shopping with Jungle Pocket.

text_block_list.name: Barker
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Colorful Parfait Fair' ends today!
You can enjoy ten different kinds of parfaits~!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: 10 varieties?! And only until today, you say?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, we've totally gotta check this out!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: “The ‘Cherry Mountain Parfait’, and the ‘Seasonal Sweets Indulgence Parfait’—”

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...
There really are ten different kinds!

text_block_list.name: Floor Clerk
text_block_list.text: Customer, are you ready to order?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'll take one of all these limited-time seasonal parfaits!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course!
Today's the only day we can eat it, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understood her point.
However, thinking about weight management brings a bit of anxiety. What should we do...?
choice_data_list: Could we at least cut it in half?
...All right, since we're here, let's eat it all!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? Why not?
You really gonna pass up this chance?
choice_data_list: If you overeat, it might affect your race.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
choice_data_list: I figured it'd suck to miss out on "strongest" just by gaining weight.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
“...... Dammit, fine, I get it.
Then this, and this... and these five types!”

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's come to this, I'm gonna savor every bite
for the guys who didn't get to order...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!
Well, miss clerk, I'm counting on ya!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
choice_data_list: You really do look so happy when you eat.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Well yeah, 'cause I'm seriously happy right now♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Tastes great, looks great!
When it comes to parfaits, I can eat as many as you give me!
